With over $7.5 trillion traded daily, the foreign exchange (Forex, or FX) market operates 24 hours a day, five days a week. It enables a wide range of participants, from central banks and investment funds to individual retail traders, to trade currency pairs and speculate on exchange rate movements.

Permite a un amplio abanico de participantes, desde bancos centrales y fondos de inversión hasta traders minoristas, operar pares de divisas y especular sobre los movimientos de los tipos de cambio.
